shipping_policy.title: Shipping Policy
shipping_policy.p1_1: We aim to process all orders within 1-2 business days.
shipping_policy.p1_2: Domestic delivery (within Qatar) typically takes 2 to 4 business days.
shipping_policy.p2_1: Shipping costs depend on the delivery location and the size of the order.
shipping_policy.p2_2: We offer free delivery in Qatar.
shipping_policy.p3_1: Once your order is shipped, you will receive an email containing your tracking number to track the status of your shipment.

privacy_policy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy_policy.p1_1: We collect information from you when you register on our site, log into your account, or make a purchase.
privacy_policy.p1_2: The collected information includes your name, email address, phone number, and credit card details.
privacy_policy.p2_1: Any of the information we collect from you may be used to:
privacy_policy.l2_1: Personalize your experience and respond to your individual needs
privacy_policy.l2_2: Improve our website based on the information and feedback we receive from you
privacy_policy.l2_3: Improve customer service and effectively support your needs
privacy_policy.p3_1: We implement a variety of security measures to maintain the safety of your personal information when you place an order or enter, submit, or access your personal information.

refund_policy.title: Refund Policy
refund_policy.p1_1: We hope you are fully satisfied with your purchase. If you are not satisfied for any reason, you may return the products under the following conditions:
refund_policy.l1_1: The product must be in its original, unused, and undamaged condition.
refund_policy.l1_2: The refund request must be made within 14 days of receiving the order.
refund_policy.l1_3: Opened or used products cannot be returned (for health and hygiene reasons related to perfumes).
refund_policy.p2_1: To initiate a return process, please contact our support team via email, and we will guide you step by step.
refund_policy.p3_1: Once your return is received and inspected, we will notify you of the approval or rejection of your refund. If approved, your refund will be processed, and a credit will automatically be applied to your original method of payment within a certain amount of days.

terms_condition.title: Terms & Conditions
terms_condition.p1_1: By using our site, you agree to be bound by these Terms & Conditions. If you do not agree to all or part of these terms, please do not use the site.
terms_condition.p2_1: We reserve the right to modify or replace these terms at any time. Your continued use of the site after any changes constitutes acceptance of those changes.
terms_condition.p3_1: If you wish to purchase any product or service made available through our site, you may be asked to supply certain information relevant to your purchase.
terms_condition.l3_1: Your credit card number and expiration date
